title: Quenched Egyptian Fish Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic Egyptian rice dish cooked with fish and infused with a hint of Thai fish sauce, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. The sous-vide technique ensures perfectly cooked fish every time, while the quenching sauce adds a rich and creamy texture.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillets (halal)
ingredients.notes: Any firm white fish works well, such as tilapia or cod

instructions: Rinse the fish fillets under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the fish with salt and pepper.
Place the fish in a sous-vide machine set to 130°F (54°C) for 1 hour.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
